The current Formula 1 World Champion is **Max Verstappen** of Red Bull Racing, who won the **2023 Formula 1 World Championship**. This marked his **second consecutive title** (after 2022) and his third overall (as of 2023). The 2023 season concluded on December 10, 2023, with Verstappen securing the championship with a 107-point lead over second-place Fernando Alonso.
